notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 0.2.1】
notes.notes:
The update to version 0.2.1 will be on August/2 (JST 12:00) for functional adjustment and bug fixes.

The details of the update are as follows.

◆ Functional Adjustment
　・You can now skip the opening and ending events from the second playthrough onwards.
　・The BGM now changes with each stage.
　・The character voices included in the SE have been added as a separate item in the game settings.
　　- With this change, the volume of SE and character voices can be adjusted separately.
　・You can now perform cancel operations on the game settings screen.

◆ Bug Fixes
　・Fixed a bug where the title screen could be operated while transitioning from the result screen to the title screen.
　・Fixed a bug where "New Record" was displayed in the result window even if the score did not surpass the first place in the local ranking.
　・Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: 【Announcing Update Version 0.2.0】
notes.notes:
The update to version 0.2.0 will be on June/28 (JST 12:00) for new functions added, functional adjustment, and bug fixes.

The details of the update are as follows.

◆ New functions
　・Added online ranking.
　　- The original ranking is now the local ranking and can be checked by switching.

◆ Functional Adjustment
　・Added more resolution options in the settings.
　・The language settings on startup now reflects the language settings of the Steam client.
　　- If a language other than Japanese, English, Chinese(Simplified), or Chinese(Traditional) is set, the in-game language will be set to English.
　・Changed the timing of score recording from after the result window display to before the result window display (immediately after the game ends).

◆ Bug Fixes
　・Fixed a bug where vertical sync was enabled.
　　- Depending on the monitor's refresh rate, the behavior after the update may feel different.
　・Fixed other minor bugs.
